claim: ADR 0340 rules 7 and 8, lane 3a (fix/menus-line-kind). menu-line-view.ts lineIsDrink(line, menuKind) is the one test: line_kind 'drink' is a drink, 'dish' is not, a line with no stored kind on a menu whose kind is in NON_DRINK_MENU_KINDS (['food', 'desserts']) is not, and otherwise the legacy rule !isKitchenLine(category, raw) decides. It is used by resolveAndPersistItems' kitchen split (so only lines it calls drinks go to resolveLibraryWinesBatch, and the carry reads kitchen_line from it), by addMenuItem and importMenu (which pass menu.menu_type ?? null), by lineForViewer's kitchen_line, and by readKitchenInventoryIds (which reads each line's menu kind from restaurant_menus). menus.service.ts no longer calls isKitchenLine directly. Checks the shape of the code; the jest cases in menus.service.spec.ts and menu-line-view.spec.ts ('a line is a drink only when stored or proven') check the behaviour. Not covered: the web's lineIsDrink (firstProof.ts) is checked only by firstProof.test.ts and the NON_DRINK_MENU_KINDS parity in A-MENU-LINE-SAYS-IF-IT-IS-A-KITCHEN-LINE. [Amended 2026-10-12 by lane 3b (feat/menus-sections-api): the batched resolver call moved out of resolveAndPersistItems into resolveDrinkLines(items, kitchen, restaurantId), which resolveAndPersistItems calls with that kitchen split and resolveOnTap reuses; the verify reads both bodies.]
